description: Prospective v34 absent-target comparison to v33, same seed 5111, 450 simulated seconds and $1.4 limit. v33 completed the vertical waypoint but then repeated a satisfied look_into_room 59 times during its final 90 seconds. Omit only stationary look tasks whose heading is already within the existing 12-degree completion tolerance while settled with a fresh usable front frame. Preserve every positional task, other headings, control choices, clearance rules and expiry. Jev chooses the next meaningful viewpoint/turn and every control. Evaluate repeated no-op looks, physical path/coverage, false reports, rule violations and provenance. Do not count this easier room-start diagnostic as cross-house success.
